zh-CN.body.backup_success: 设备 ${device_name} 备份成功完成
zh-CN.body.backup_failed:
设备 ${device_name} 备份失败
原因: ${reason}
zh-CN.body.system_error: 操作未能完成。请查看应用状态和日志中的诊断信息。
zh-CN.body.pairing_required: 设备 ${device_name} 的自动备份检查持续无法通过配对校验。请通过 USB 连接设备，解锁并确认“信任此电脑”，然后重试。
zh-CN.body.connection_service_unavailable: 设备列表已连续多次查询失败，暂时无法确认设备状态或开始新备份。请查看连接服务状态及日志；如自动恢复未成功，请检查容器和设备连接。
zh-CN.title.encryption_password_store_failed: ⚠️ 备份加密密码存储失败
zh-CN.body.encryption_password_store_failed: 设备加密设置已更改，但密码存储失败。请保管本次使用的密码，检查配置存储后重新保存密码。
zh-CN.body.password_store_failed: 密码存储失败。请保管设备当前的备份密码，检查配置存储后重新保存。
zh-CN.body.encryption_failed: 备份加密设置操作失败。请检查设备连接、授权提示和当前密码，查看诊断日志后重试。
zh-CN.body.password_change_failed: 备份密码修改失败。请保管新旧密码，确认设备上的加密状态并查看诊断日志后重试。
zh-CN.body.restore_failed: 设备恢复未能完成。请检查设备状态、连接和备份密码，查看诊断日志后再决定下一步。
zh-CN.body.unpack_failed: 备份解包未能完成。请检查备份格式、目标目录空间和写入权限，并查看诊断日志。
zh-CN.reason.storage_unavailable: 存储不可用，请检查空间和写入权限。
zh-CN.test.title: 🧪 测试通知
zh-CN.test.body: 这是一条测试通知，用于验证通知配置。
zh-CN.reason.unknown: 备份未能完成，请查看诊断日志。
zh-CN.reason.device_locked: 设备需要授权，请查看手机并输入锁屏密码。
zh-CN.reason.pairing_required: 设备需要重新配对，请通过 USB 连接并确认信任。
zh-CN.reason.backup_stalled: 长时间未检测到备份活动，任务已停止。
zh-CN.reason.device_disconnected: 设备已断开，请重新连接后重试。
zh-CN.reason.device_offline: 设备已离线，请重新连接后重试。
zh-CN.reason.backup_timeout: 备份已超时，请检查设备和连接。
zh-CN.reason.storage_error: 存储不可用，请检查空间和写入权限。
zh-CN.label.subject: iOS备份通知
zh-CN.test.reason: 用于测试通知的模拟故障

en.body.system_error: The operation could not be completed. Check the application status and diagnostic logs.
en.body.pairing_required: Automatic backup checks for ${device_name} repeatedly failed pairing validation. Connect the device over USB, unlock it and confirm Trust This Computer, then retry.
en.body.connection_service_unavailable: Device discovery repeatedly failed, so device status cannot be confirmed and new backups cannot start. Check connection service status and logs. If automatic recovery fails, check the container and device connections.
en.title.encryption_password_store_failed: ⚠️ Backup encryption password was not saved
en.body.encryption_password_store_failed: The device encryption setting changed, but the password could not be saved. Keep the password you used, check configuration storage and save it again.
en.body.password_store_failed: The backup password could not be saved. Keep the device's current backup password, check configuration storage and save it again.
en.title.encryption_failed: ⚠️ Backup encryption settings could not be changed
en.body.encryption_failed: Changing backup encryption failed. Check the device connection, authorization prompts and current password, then review diagnostic logs before retrying.
en.title.password_change_failed: ⚠️ Backup password could not be changed
en.body.password_change_failed: Changing the backup password failed. Keep both passwords, confirm the device's encryption state and review diagnostic logs before retrying.
en.body.restore_failed: Device restore did not complete. Check the device state, connection and backup password, and review diagnostic logs before choosing the next action.
en.body.unpack_failed: Backup unpack did not complete. Check the backup format, destination free space and write permissions, and review diagnostic logs.
en.reason.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable. Check free space and write permissions.
en.test.title: 🧪 Test notification
en.test.body: This is a test notification to verify notification settings.
en.reason.unknown: The backup could not be completed. Check the diagnostic logs.
en.reason.device_locked: Device authorization is required. Check the phone and enter its passcode.
en.reason.pairing_required: Pairing is required. Connect over USB and confirm trust.
en.reason.backup_stalled: No backup activity was detected within the time limit, so the job stopped.
en.reason.device_disconnected: The device disconnected. Reconnect it and retry.
en.reason.device_offline: The device is offline. Reconnect it and retry.
en.reason.backup_timeout: The backup timed out. Check the device and connection.
en.reason.storage_error: Storage is unavailable. Check free space and write permissions.
en.label.subject: iOS Backup notification
